purpose: Build, measure and evolve Autonomously Self-Improving Factories: maintain the ASIF template and rulebook that any repository can adopt, and consult member factories on their process health, cadence and autonomy.

owns: the ASIF template and rulebook (TEMPLATE/ and the derived laws)
member-factory surveys, scores and the measurement cadence
does_not_own: member factories' products, backlogs, repos and code
member factories' ontologies and issue boards
the OpenCrabs runtime, daemon and core tools - a client-supplier loop, not ownership
token provisioning, model routing and inference pricing (InferHub Watch)

announcements.text: Pacemaker cron triggers on this box still pass --mode quiet, although the owner re-ruling of 2026-09-19T03:34:30Z / 03:36:54Z made turn-end THE default for all lane traffic and retained quiet only for batch/fan-out notices whose ack contract is the ledger. announcements.text: Brain metrics are a STANDING reading with an instrument: tools/brain_metrics.py (no args needed; --home / --hours / --log-dir) prints all three legs with their predicate, population and instant, and gates none of them. First measured and written up by hand at evidence/brain-metrics-2026-09-19.md. Read afresh 2026-09-21T22:48:40Z (docs/measurement-procedure.md section 5): ALWAYS-INJECTED FILES (leg A; the Tier 0 triple SOUL.md, USER.md, AGENTS.md named in docs/methodology/04-harness-binding.md; these files live in NO repository, so a leg-A reading has an instant for its identity and no revision) 670 lines / 104881 bytes, about 29965 tokens = 14.98 percent of a 200k window. SKILL BODIES (leg B; every skills/*/SKILL.md at depth 1) 667 lines / 66518 bytes, about 19005 tokens = 9.50 percent; the main body skills/meta-factory/SKILL.md is 667 lines, 167 over the owner's 500-line budget marker (the marker is PRINTED, never gated). TOGETHER 1337 lines / 171399 bytes, about 48970 tokens = 24.48 percent of the window, paid before a session reads its first message. POST-COMPACTION INPUT TOKENS (leg C; daemon-log lines matching 'Compaction: sending N / N messages to summarizer (X / Y input tokens, reserving Z for output)' at context.rs, read streaming) over n=2415 events in the 24 h to 2026-09-21T22:48:40Z: mean 38386 input tokens = 19.2 percent of the window, median 25617 = 12.8 percent, p90 100000 = 50.0 percent. The event COUNT tracks how many lanes were awake and how many turns they ran, NOT the weight of the law -- read the mean/median as the floor signal. The 2026-09-19 oracle figures are printed BESIDE the live reading with the delta named and are never asserted as current; a nonzero delta is movement of the corpus over the interval between the two reads. The oracle's own numbers live where they were measured (evidence/brain-metrics-2026-09-19.md) and are carried by the instrument, deliberately NOT restated here: a figure copied into a claim about live state is stale before it is committed, and this claim was already invalidated once inside the hour it was written. CAUTION: the trigger line Context at NN percent (>65 percent) at compaction.rs uses a DIFFERENT denominator (effective_token_count over effective_max, window minus reserves) and must never be read as a fraction of the provider window.
